recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration review the integration of United Nations information centres, as requested by the General Assembly, with a view to establishing a sustained and structured mechanism for the Development Coordination Office and the Department of Global Communications, clarify the line of reporting and command, align strategic and programmatic planning and ensure that mandates, programmes and activities are developed in order to accommodate the mandates of both offices to fully reap the envisaged benefits of the development reform.
